lines.caption: Tap Slower once
lines.text: Let's practise first. Tap Slower once.

lines.caption: Slower again to stop
lines.text: Good, we slowed to 30. Now tap Slower again to stop.

lines.caption: Tap Faster
lines.text: We stopped. Now tap Faster to drive at 30.

lines.caption: Faster again to 50
lines.text: Tap Faster again to go back to 50.

lines.caption: You're ready!
lines.text: Great, you're ready!

lines.caption: Wait, then tap
lines.text: Let's wait until the speed stops changing, then tap again.

lines.caption: Back to 50
lines.text: The limit here is 50. Let's tap Slower once to go back to 50.

lines.caption: Let's go
lines.text: Here we go!

lines.caption: Let's try again
lines.text: Let's give it another go! Watch the road and the signs, and look both ways at stops.

lines.caption: No hints this time
lines.text: This is the final drive. I'll stay quiet this time. Remember what we practised. You can do it.

lines.caption: Next one coming up
lines.text: Nicely done. Relax. The next situation is coming up.

lines.caption: Go when it's clear
lines.text: When the way is clear, tap Faster to get going.

lines.caption: You passed!
lines.text: That's it, well done! You can try it again or pick another one.

lines.caption: You passed the test!
lines.text: You made it through all 5! Safe driving, great job.

lines.caption: Time's up
lines.text: Time's up for this drive. Thanks for practising with me!

lines.caption: Swipe to look
lines.text: Turning the phone isn't working here, so swipe the screen to look around instead.

lines.caption: Too fast here
lines.text: We went over the speed limit. Next time, watch for the MAXIMUM sign and tap Slower a little sooner.

lines.caption: The car behind bumped us
lines.text: The car behind hit us after we tapped Slower again while still slowing down. Next time, let's tap once, wait until the speed stops changing, then tap again.

lines.caption: Stop sign ahead
lines.text: Stop sign ahead. Stop at the white line.

lines.caption: Flashing red ahead
lines.text: Flashing red light. Stop at the white line.

lines.caption: Look left, right, left
lines.text: Good stop. Look left, right, then left again. Go when clear.

lines.caption: Look left, right, left
lines.text: Good stop. We're a little early. Look left, right, then left again. Go when clear.

lines.caption: Move up to the line
lines.text: Let's move a little closer. Tap Faster, then stop at the white line.

lines.caption: Stop, look, go
lines.text: Well done: stop, look both ways, go.

lines.caption: Stop, look, go
lines.text: Well done. Flashing red: stop, look, go.

lines.caption: Look both ways
lines.text: Tip: always look both ways before you go.

lines.caption: Stop fully at the line
lines.text: At a stop sign, let's stop completely at the white line, then check both ways.

lines.caption: Stop fully at the line
lines.text: A flashing red light means a full stop at the line. Then we can go when it's clear.

lines.caption: Car from the {side}
lines.text: A car from the {side} was only {m} metres away. Look left and right, and wait until both sides are clear.

lines.caption: We hit a crossing car
lines.text: We hit a crossing car. Next time, let's look both ways and wait until both sides are clear.

lines.caption: Truck ahead: slow down
lines.text: Parked truck ahead. Someone could be behind it. Tap Slower.

lines.caption: Someone stepping out!
lines.text: Someone is stepping out!

lines.caption: Dog in the road!
lines.text: A dog is running into the road!

lines.caption: All clear: Faster
lines.text: They are across. Tap Faster.

lines.caption: All clear: Faster
lines.text: The dog is across. Tap Faster.

lines.caption: Slow near parked trucks
lines.text: Nice. Slow down beside parked trucks.

lines.caption: Slow down near trucks
lines.text: They were in our path. Slowing down near parked trucks gives us time to stop.

lines.caption: Stop when they step out
lines.text: We slowed down, good. When someone steps out, tap Slower again right away to stop.

lines.caption: Slow down near trucks
lines.text: The dog was in our path. Slowing down near parked trucks gives us time to stop.

lines.caption: School zone: 30
lines.text: School zone ahead: school day, 8:30 a.m. Slow to 30 before the sign.

lines.caption: Back to 50
lines.text: School zone over. You can go 50 again.

lines.caption: School zones: 30
lines.text: Great. School zones: 30 on school days.

lines.caption: 30 in school zones
lines.text: In a school zone the limit is 30 km/h on school days, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Let's stay at 30 until the 50 sign.

lines.caption: Playground zone: 30
lines.text: Playground zone ahead. Slow to 30 before the sign.

lines.caption: Ball! Child may follow
lines.text: Ball in the road! A child may follow.

lines.caption: Child safe: Faster once
lines.text: The child is safe. Tap Faster once. Still 30 here.

lines.caption: Ball means child nearby
lines.text: Good. A ball often means a child is near.

lines.caption: Stop and wait
lines.text: A child ran after the ball. Let's stop and wait until they're off the road.

lines.caption: 30 in playground zones
lines.text: Playground zones are 30 km/h from dawn to dusk, every day. Let's stay at 30 until the 50 sign.

lines.caption: Up to 80: watch ahead
lines.text: Bigger road: up to 80. Watch the car ahead.

lines.caption: Brake lights: Slower
lines.text: Brake lights ahead! Tap Slower.

lines.caption: Safe, but try 80
lines.text: We stayed slow, which is safe. Next time, speed up to 80 and stay 2 seconds behind.

lines.caption: Keep a 2-second gap
lines.text: Good distance. Stay 2 seconds behind (3 on highways).

lines.caption: Slow down sooner
lines.text: We hit the car ahead. Next time, tap Slower as soon as the brake lights come on.

lines.caption: Too close
lines.text: Let's leave more room for the car ahead. Keep at least 2 seconds behind it (3 seconds on highways).

lines.caption: Siren! Look behind
lines.text: Ambulance behind us! We move right. Tap Slower and stop.

lines.caption: It's passed: Faster
lines.text: It has passed. When clear, tap Faster.

lines.caption: Pull right and stop
lines.text: Well done. Lights or siren: pull right and stop.

lines.caption: Wait until it passes
lines.text: Let's wait until the ambulance has completely passed before moving again.

lines.caption: Pull right and stop
lines.text: For an ambulance with lights or a siren, pull right and stop when it is safe. Let it pass.

lines.caption: We were in its way
lines.text: Let's give the ambulance a clear path. Pull over to the right and stop.

lines.caption: Stop until it passes
lines.text: Let's pull over and stay stopped until the ambulance has gone by.

lines.caption: School bus slowing
lines.text: School bus ahead with amber lights. It will stop. Tap Slower.

lines.caption: Red lights: stop
lines.text: Red lights and STOP arm! Stop and wait.

lines.caption: Lights off: Faster
lines.text: Lights off, child safe. Tap Faster.

lines.caption: Red lights: all stop
lines.text: Red lights on a bus: all cars stop, both ways.

lines.caption: Stop for red lights
lines.text: When a school bus has flashing red lights, let's stop and wait. This applies to traffic in both directions.
